title: Informal Economy Database

perception_sources.source: World Economic Forum Executive Opinion Surveys

source_page_claims.count_reconciliation: Concept-level arithmetic reconciles: one informal-output concept is estimated using two alternative methods (DGE and MIMIC), plus four employment indicators and six perception indicators, yielding 11 conceptual measures. This does not validate the exact workbook column/panel inventory; inspect and reconcile the actual DGE_Raw.xlsx worksheets and the 2021 methodology paper before importing observations.

license_review.general_world_bank_terms_summary: World Bank Data Catalog datasets default to CC BY 4.0 unless specifically labeled otherwise; third-party datasets may have separate restrictions.
license_review.interpretation_limit: The label Custom license is a reason to establish the exact governing terms, not proof that the dataset is prohibited or permitted for redistribution. A reproducibility package says publicly available and included; that is evidence of availability, not a complete rights analysis. False approval flags mean not approved by this project pending review, not a legal finding that usage is forbidden.
license_review.required_next_action: Determine whether the actual workbook is governed by the linked World Bank dataset terms or a dataset-specific notice, then record explicit rights evidence for attribution, modification, redistribution, and commercial use before ingestion or publication.

qualification_gates: confirm exact workbook edition and digest
capture workbook sheet and variable inventory without altering the original
reconcile measure count against the 2021 methodology paper and workbook variables
record definition, unit, denominator, geography, period, method, missingness and source for each variable
separate DGE and MIMIC estimates as alternative model-based measures; do not average or sum by default
separate model estimates from survey-derived employment and perception indicators
check country-year coverage and missingness before comparing economies
resolve source-specific terms and third-party restrictions before any data redistribution or commercial use
do not infer illegality or adjudicated illicit output from informality estimates
interpretation_ceiling: Historical cross-country context only after the workbook variables, methods, coverage and terms have been independently qualified; not a current-year estimate, not a complete global shadow-economy total, and not evidence of illegal activity.

official_asset.label: Informal economy data (Excel)
official_asset.note: The official page links to an Excel download. The bytes have not been retrieved and inspected in this review; do not claim workbook sheet/column inventory or a digest.

reproducibility_package_evidence.interpretation: The package metadata establishes that a 2026 reproduction effort reports the dataset publicly available and included in its package, while applying a Custom license label and linking the World Bank dataset terms. This is stronger availability evidence than a generic source-page link, but does not alone establish the exact permissions for copying, redistributing, modifying, or commercial use of the workbook. Resolve the governing dataset-specific terms before incorporating workbook bytes or derived data into the public product.
